rv.t: 「店（みせ）」という言葉は「見世棚（みせだな）」が変化したものである。平安末期から商品を陳列して客に見せるものとして、「見世棚」という言葉が使われるようになった。 「世界大百科事典 第２版（平凡社）」によると、「棚」に変わり「店」という言葉が使われるようになったのは室町期。初期の店は建物から見世棚を外につき出して商品を並べていたが、戦国期には撤廃して店の内部を開放するという方法がとられた。尚、漢字の「店」は、「一定の空間を占めて商売を行う場所」という意味がある。 この店という存在は、お客さまに商品を実際に見てもらって、その良し悪しを判断してもらい、購入してもらうという場所である。ただ本当に、店は商品を「見せ」て売るだけの場所なのだろうか。…

2970.edj: クチコミによると、このグランピング施設は清潔で設備の整った部屋と、美味しくてボリューム満点のバーベキューディナーが好評です。美しい星空や、飲み放題のドリンク、ピザ作りやキャンプファイヤーといった楽しいアクティビティも高く評価されています。また、スタッフの親しみやすく、親切で、きめ細やかなサービスも、利用した人から一貫して称賛されています。

rv.t: Our family of 3 enjoyed everyday at Mokki! The staff were kind and professional. The camp was very clean, welcoming and even though we had rainy days we were recharged and refreshed! Will definitely go again.

Service was great, all staff was friendly and on our check out, one of them offered to take photos for us too! Food was also delicious, from the bbq dinner to the breakfast but serving was huge so we were very full. The sky was cloudy and it was raining when we checked in but the sky cleared up and by midnight, we could see a lot of stars and love that moment! Went back into the tent when we were cold and out again…

The 5 stars very much depends on one's willingness to accept an accommodation format that is very different from the traditional. Although it was our first time glamoing, we found it very well executed. So many small details were organized, but need to be prepared for everything to be "self-serve". They provide all the materials along with instructions on "how to" - to the extent of a diagram on how to construct a…

rv.t: Interesting museum out in the suburbs of Chiba next to a large park. Mostly portrait paintings with some still life, and landscapes. Limited amount of artwork but what they have is displayed very well. The building's architecture is almost as interesting as the art. Nice little cafe on the lower level with small sandwiches and dessert. Very appealing looking more formal Italian restaurant at the front entrance, but…
This is a stylish museum for Realistic paintings. The architecture is fantastic and lighting and design are also good to appreciate. Photography forbidden.

Beautiful artworks inside. Aircond was awesome. The height of the ceiling was great. The long slow walks I took as I enjoyed each artwork was very therapeutic. I wasn't sure what I'm looking at but the ones with scenery was amazing. There's a small cafe tucked inside there for some refreshments. Great glass placement for viewing. Exterior architectural is really nice.

2972.a: Glass Fish, 1889 Chikuracho Kitaasai, Minamiboso, Chiba 295-0011, Japan
2972.aj: 〒295-0011 千葉県南房総市千倉町北朝夷１８８９ グラスフィッシュ

rv.t: What can I say about Glass Fish and Oba-sensai? A charming studio, with a friendly, passionate artist for an instructor. Our group of beginners had great fun learning how to create beautiful glasses and vases...very much a social event as much as it was a class. But you can go individually too. Complete with cute, affectionate cat who loves to sleep against the kiln! If you want a lesson and happen to be in Chikura…

私は3度目の体験、次女にとっては初めてでした お約束の時間に大遅刻してしまったのに母子ふたりに丁寧にお教えいただき、不器用な母もなんとか作品を仕上げる事が出来ました それだけでなく言葉の端々にお人柄がしのばれやはりお訪ねして良かった、いつかまた再訪したいと思いました 自然に囲まれた工房迄の道も 鶯の声を聞くことも東京では 体験できなくなって久しいです命の洗濯とはこの事かと思いました まあるい穴の向こうの火の色にも生命を感じました 東京の作品展にも是非うかがうつもりです

rv.t: Food is delicious , the view is amazing. Star glazing at room is great.

Stayed one night at Villa Santorini, a splurge overnight stay while on a hiking trip, doing part of the ancient henro pilgrimage route on Shikoku. The place is a perfect replica of a typical Greek costal village, perched on a high bluff above the rugged coastline of Kochi Prefecture. Absolutely gorgeous setting! The rooms are nicely appointed with minibar/minifridge, spa tub and shower, and comfortable bedding…

Beautiful view from the mountains if Koichi over the ocean. It was cloudy our first day, but the next morning was beautiful! The atmosphere at the hotel was surreal and the staff was quite friendly and helpful. The building itself seemed a bit old, but it wasn't a problem overall. The food was delicious and plentiful, both dinner and breakfast. The drinks seemed a bit overpriced but they did have a few Greek and…

rv.t: We were here for 3 nights in July 2026 as first timer to Yakushima. We actually didn't know about this hotel until we found it via Hilton network. I had a wonderful stay at Sadakata Hotel in Yakushima. The meals were absolutely delicious—perfect after a long day of hiking—and…

The food was incredible - the curry was one of a kind, and the baked apple french toast felt like divinity in my mouth with every bite - warm, crispy then soft and juicy with an incredible amount of flavor. 10/10 would recommend

Great simple cafe to start the morning. The set is simply amazing. The thick toast is really thick and it’s so soft. The toast is made with great yeast that is good to go with the spread over of the butter that melts perfectly on top of it. It’s not oily at all. The hard boiled egg is soft in the middle. Coffee is the strong espresso shots.

Stumbled upon this cafe on an early morning when nothing else was open and it was great! The French toast isn’t an option until after 10:30am but the breakfast set meal that is available 7-10:30am was delicious and satisfying. I got the soup, yogurt (it came plain with honey), iced milk coffee (like an iced latte), and ham and cheese toast. I highly recommend this combo. Everything was fresh and tasty. Calm…

rv.t: Kotai Jingu (Naiku) is Japan's most sacred Shinto shrine, dedicated to the sun goddess Amaterasu. The approach alone is breathtaking—you'll cross the elegant wooden Uji Bridge, which spans the clear Isuzu River and marks the transition from everyday life into the divine. As you step onto the bridge, you'll spot a Japanese flag on your right, fluttering against the lush greenery—a simple but striking sight. Inside…

Ise Jingu is considered one of the most sacred and important spiritual sites for Japanese people. It’s often called the soul of Japan, and you can truly feel that significance the moment you step onto the grounds. The atmosphere is incredibly peaceful and solemn, surrounded by ancient trees and the sound of the Isuzu River. Walking through the forest to reach the main shrines felt like a deep spiritual cleansing…

This shrine is not just a tourist spot. It is a living sacred place full of nature and history. I felt relaxed and amazed at the same time. I strongly recommend visiting Naiku. It is one of the most beautiful and spiritual places in Japan. Highly recommended

2977.a: Glamp Ocean Iseshima, 1693-1 Futamicho Matsushita, Ise, Mie 519-0601, Japan

Although the dinner was okay and there’s almost no signals, wifi is quite slow, I still recommend here as everyone comes here to enjoy the nature, don’t you ?
The best service provided, our car' battery was gone, they gave us a big helping hand. Gorgeous scenery with Sakura, nice food, best service, highly recommended.
The first time experience at glamp ocean is very interesting, the sunset & sunrise view is so wonderful. Very suitable as the place of choice for vacations. I will come back here in the near future.

Most beautiful place in Oki!
So beautiful!

Had a quick visit and walk around the University. Wish I had this kind of campus during my college years. Lovely lovely campus.
Huge university. If you go by walk, do think twice of strong feet or not. Beautiful sightseeing, I love it.

Visiting the lighthouse is worthwhile. We were lucky to even spot some deer 🦌. A beautiful path and a short walk to an amazing scenery.

MUST SEE THIS LANDSCAPE! REMARKABLE. for walking traveller: its far from Fukue main street. from fort, there are only 4-5 buses a day. Its took a 1.5h by bus, then, from bus station to light house you have to walk along a slope way over 1h. (I recommend hitchhiking) But if you have a car, Absolutely no problem.

rv.t: I recently returned from a Costa cruise that included a stop in Ishigaki, Okinawa – a small, unspoiled gem that completely stole my heart. While the cruise itself offered comfort and beautiful sea views, the real highlight was docking in this peaceful Japanese town. What made the trip unforgettable was the authentic Japanese food. Away from the busy tourist spots, I found small, family-run eateries serving…

Southernmost Japanese island next to Taiwan. Difficult to get around without a rental car. Most of the tourists are Japanese, I did not see any foreigners. A small island, shops closed early and people spoke little English.
Beautiful beaches. City lacks touristic infrastructure as cafe, electronic payments, English signs, food variety in the restaurants.

2982.a: Jōmon Sugi, Miyanoura, Yakushima, Kumage District, Kagoshima 891-4205, Japan
2982.aj: 〒891-4205 鹿児島県熊毛郡屋久島町宮之浦縄文杉

2982.edj: 雲をつくような樹齢数千年の杉の木。日本最古の木とされ、巡礼の対象ともなっている。

rv.t: We hiked through Shiratani both ways, its our second time doing this enormous day hike to see the majestic giant Jomon Sugi. I'd do it every year if I could! It's hard to put in words the palpable energy of this primordial forest, especially as you start getting closer to the great cedars and see giants one by one, each having a distinct personality.
The trail to Jomon Sugi can be a bit challenging in some parts of the climb, but once you're standing in front of this gigantic cedar, it's well worth the effort !

Jomon sugi is just a big tree, you cannot even touch it. There are viewing decks 50meters away from the tree. What made the 10hour trek worth it is the breathtaking sceneries along the trek. Every rest, I can’t stop saying it’s so beautiful here.. Straight out of the fairytale book. Pictures don’t do justice. The view is so inspiring. I understand why Hayao Miyazaki got inspired by the forest and used it in his…

2983.ed: Guests mention this villa offers stunning ocean views from every room, with many enjoying the sunset and the soothing sound of waves. They also highlight the stylish, clean rooms with jacuzzis and convenient amenities like EV charging and outdoor showers. 2983.edj: このヴィラを利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、全室オーシャンビューで、どの部屋からも素晴らしい海の景色が楽しめることが高く評価されています。多くの人が夕日や波の音に癒される時間を楽しんでいるようです。また、ジャグジー付きのスタイリッシュで清潔な部屋や、EV充電、屋外シャワーといった便利な設備も好評です。プライベートな非接触チェックインも、リラックスして過ごせる隠れ家のような体験ができると喜ばれています。

rv.t: Nice sunset view of Nihon sea. It’s sooooo amazing !

コンパクトながら洗練された客室は、全室オーシャンビューでとても癒されました。 窓を開けると波の音が聞こえて、時間の経過と共に移りゆく景色にも感動。 海を長めながら入れるジャグジーバスが得にお気に入りです。 こちらに到着して1回目の入浴、就寝前に2回目、翌朝に3回目の絶景風呂を楽しみました(笑) 徒歩3分で海水浴場にも行けるため、夏場のおでかけにもピッタリだと思います。 玄関にはシャワーもあるため、砂を流してから客室に入れるところも機能的でよかったです。 電子レンジやホットプレート、炊飯器やトースターなどがあり、使用した食器類は洗わずにコンテナボックスに入れるところが新鮮でした（詰まり防止のため） リビング、寝室、お風呂、どこに居ても海を間近に感じられてよかったです。 また機会がありましたら、利用させていただきます。

全室オーシャンビューで、どのお部屋からも海を一望できる贅沢なロケーション。時間とともに表情を変える海と空を眺めながら、非日常のひとときを満喫できます。 すぐ目の前の日本海の波の音に癒されながら 夕日も見れて本当に最高でした。 お部屋の内装もかなりこられていて私の宿泊した部屋はスペイン・マヨルカ島をイメージした空間は、まるで海外リゾートのようでした。 本当にここは日本ではない感じでジャグジーも良かったし海見ながらお風呂に入れるのも良かった。 キッチンもついてるので料理もできるのも嬉しい。 チェックインは非接触型のセルフチェックインを採用。 事前案内に沿ってスムーズに入室できるので、自分たちのペースでゆったりと滞在を始められるのも魅力です。 最高すぎて、また宿泊したいです！

For the price you pay, you expect more from this. We were also told that the private hot springs were free to use, but were charged 2200 yen per session when we left, which was…

They also highlight the warm, fairytale-like atmosphere and the opportunity to take photos of the exhibits. rv.t: I don't understand why there are people here complaining about 1) How small the museum is 2) How far out they had to travel only for it to be closed, and 3) The entrance fee. The coffee is exceptional. You can tell that every bean has been carefully selected, and every drink is prepared with remarkable precision. I…

I strongly advise foreign tourists against visiting this place. 2989.a: Tokyo Tower, 4 Chome-2-8 Shibakoen, Minato City, Tokyo 105-0011, Japan

2989.edj: 1958年に竣工された高さ333mの電波塔。東京のシンボルとして知られ、高さ150mと250mの2つの展望台と飲食施設を備える。

rv.t: As we arrived at Tokyo Tower aka (Japan Radio Tower) in the district of Shiba-koen in Minato, the smell of pumpkin spice emanating from a coffee vendor, Christmas songs in their original English language, and twinkling displays overwhelmed our senses. It was a pleasant surprise and made us feel at home for the holiday season. Once inside, girls clad in pink outfits reminiscent of 1960s stewardesses pointed the way…

Tokyo Tower is a beautifully iconic landmark that offers a classic and elegant view of the city. Its red and white structure stands out instantly and gives a nostalgic charm, reminding visitors of older Tokyo while still blending into the modern skyline. The observation decks provide stunning panoramic views of the city, especially at sunset and after dark when Tokyo lights up completely. On a clear day, you can…

You don’t have to go up Tokyo Tower to appreciate it. We loved wandering the streets around it, finding different angles, and watching it tower over the city. It looks especially beautiful when the lights come on in the evening. A classic Tokyo landmark that never gets old.

rv.t: Mogami San is a master to learn from. His woodworking is something I have never seen and I am truly honored to have spent the few hours learning from him. My wife and I visited as part of our honeymoon and I truly feel it was the best experience we have had so far in Japan. We were very fortunate to learn how to make chopsticks from him. Thank you, Mogami San and thank you Saori

otonamiというサイトから『お箸づくり』のワークショップへ参加しました。 先生の茂上豊さんは江戸指物の職人さん。 指物についての歴史をお話はとても興味深いものでした。 お箸は木をカンナで削って作っていくのですが、とても繊細な作業で難しい.... でもポイントポイントで先生が確認やアドバイス、修正をしてくださり、完成まで約1時間半くらいでした。 とても綺麗なお箸ができ感動。 茂上先生は、本当に丁寧で優しくてすごく魅力溢れた素敵な職人さんでした。 もっと時間があればお話したかったな。 時間が経つのはあっという間で、本当に貴重な体験でした。 また訪れたい工房です

🪄 Dream came true today! If you want to truly experience coffee in Tokyo, this is definitely a place worth visiting at least once. It feels quite different from a typical café, with a calm and focused atmosphere throughout.
